blocks.text: MANDUE CITY, Cebu – The hearing on the three counts of cyber libel against radio commentator and boxing judge Edward Ligas is set to begin in January 2027 after he and the complainant, ZLREJ Trading and Construction Corp., failed to reach an amicable settlement. Mediation proceedings were held at Branch 65 of the Talisay City Regional Trial Court (RTC) on Thursday, November 5. “The private complainant is closed to an amicable settlement.
